assertions.assertion: The claim was denied by Atlas Mutual.
The service at issue is CPT 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The denial was issued under reason code CO-50.
The denial reason was that the service was not medically necessary.
A clinical indication note exists documenting the patient's presentation.
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations.
Intermittent palpitations are coded as R00.2.
The patient has episodes of dizziness.
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded as I34.0.
There is an order for mobile cardiac telemetry.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture continuous rhythm data.
The monitoring is intended to correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias.
